streamlit help documents the Python CLI; the Rust binary exposes its own flags, and there is no Python CLI to document.
streamlit init scaffolds a Python app project; the Rust integration path is a cargo dependency (see docs/guide), not a scaffolder.

streamlit run launches a Python script through the Python runtime; Rust apps are compiled binaries whose serving surface is what every journey exercises (W01-W07 evidence), so there is no script launcher to port.
streamlit skills is Python CLI tooling; no Rust counterpart exists or is claimed.

streamlit version prints the Python package version; the Rust crate carries its own version metadata and the wire identifies as 1.66.1 (new_session environment info), which is the compatibility-relevant identity.
